description: SL Verkehrsnetze ATKIS Basis-DLM - Fährroute - OGC API Features is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. This service provides data implemented for the INSPIRE topic Transport Networks from ATKIS Basic DLM.: A special section of waterways intended to facilitate the transport of passengers, vehicles or freight across a body of water and normally serving as a connection between two or more transport hubs of a land-based transport network. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "INSPIRE-WFS SL Transport Networks ATKIS Base DLM - Ferry Route - OGC API Features" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include infoFeatureAccessService, HVD, Fährroute, opendata, AdVMIS, Ferry Crossing. The listing shows 2025-11-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
